summary: Galiano Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with management's discussion and analysis and CEO/CFO certifications. There is no mention of a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16. No special-situation category applies.
